en.hubeali: Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Alawy, from Sahl Bin Jamhour, from Abdul Azeem Bin Abdullah Al Alawy, from Al Hassan Bin Al Husayn Al Uranny, from Amro Bin Jumi’e who said,

‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about the Salāt in the Masjid with pictures. So heasws said: ‘That is abhorred, but that would not harm you today, and if the justice had been established (Al-Qaimasws), you would see what would be done regarding that’.
en.sarwar: 6. Al-Husayn ibn Ali al-‘Alaviy has narrated from al-Hassan ibn al-Husayn al-‘Uraniy from ‘Amr ibn Jumay’ who has said the following:

“I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, if it is permissible to perform Salah (prayer) in a Masjid with pictures. He (the Imam) said, ‘I dislike it, however, today it is not harmful to you. Had justice been established you would see how it is dealt with.’”
